Potatoes

Olive oil spray

Beef
1½ lb (680g) lean ground beef (93/7 or leaner)
1 small onion, diced
1 packet (28g) low-sodium taco seasoning (or homemade)
¼ cup (60ml) beef bone broth

Toppings
½ cup fresh guacamole
½ cup pico de gallo
Pickled jalapeños (optional)

1 chipotle pepper in adobo + 1 tsp adobo sauce

½ tsp honey (or agave)
Handful fresh cilantro
Pinch of salt
👉🏻Blend until smooth and bright

Protein: 46g
